name: Jacques Cartier Bridge
blurb: Steel cantilever truss from 1930, lit at night by thousands of LEDs whose colours follow the seasons.

name: Samuel De Champlain Bridge
blurb: The cable-stayed crossing that replaced the old Champlain in 2019; its harp pylon rises 170 m over the Seaway.

name: Victoria Bridge
blurb: Opened in 1859 as the first bridge across the St. Lawrence; still carries trains and cars.

name: Honoré Mercier Bridge
blurb: 1934 steel truss linking Lachine and Kahnawake.

name: Concorde Bridge
blurb: Built for Expo 67, from the Cité du Havre to the islands of Parc Jean-Drapeau.

name: Papineau-Leblanc Bridge
blurb: Cable-stayed crossing to Laval, 1969, with its slender pylons.
